phases.title: Newton robustness and adaptive-control contract
phases.scope: Inventory current authorities, freeze residual/convergence/stagnation/line-search/retry contracts, define baseline campaign and gates.

phases.title: Stagnation and line-search authority
phases.scope: Implement one deterministic stagnation and line-search policy behind the authoritative driver; retain delegating compatibility wrappers.

phases.title: Adaptive increment and cutback consolidation
phases.scope: Consolidate adaptive load-control retry, cutback, growth and terminal policy behind one deterministic authority while preserving accepted composite state semantics.

phases.title: Arc-length robustness boundary
phases.scope: Integrate specialized arc-length retry/radius diagnostics with one common robustness policy, preserve rollback-before-retry and target-clipped progress, without changing arc mathematics.

phases.title: Independent robustness closure audit
phases.scope: Adversarial replay of the baseline campaign, deterministic failures, easy-case preservation and difficult-case evidence.

closure_policy: No WP03 points are awarded in WP03-A, WP03-B, WP03-C or WP03-D. WP03 closure requires independent WP03-E review; no difficult physical-case improvement is claimed in WP03-D.
